response.sql: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) as address_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) as fraction FROM address GROUP BY city_id) SELECT city_id, address_count, fraction FROM city_counts WHERE fraction >= (SELECT MIN(fraction) FROM (SELECT fraction FROM city_counts ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10) t) ORDER BY fraction DESC, city_id;

assumptions.assumption: When the request says 'every city whose address count ties with the 10th-place city', it refers to ties in the fraction value (the sorting column), not in the raw address count. This reading is supported by the request's explicit instruction to sort by fraction.
